   * **Programming Agreements:** WYZZ retains *"exclusive authority for the negotiation, preparation, execution and implementation of any and all programming agreements for WYZZ-TV"* (*Section 6(a)(iii), Page 4*).

2. **Exclusive Sales Representatives / Dedicated Personnel:**
   * Nexstar is required to maintain two separate sales forces (one for each station) (*Section 10(b), Page 7*), and upon termination of the agreement, WYZZ is obligated to hire Nexstar employees who were solely providing services to WYZZ-TV, including account executives *"exclusively selling time on WYZZ-TV"* (*Section 24(g), Page 12*).

3. **Exclusivity in Accounts Receivable Collection:**
   * During the 180-day Collection Period, Nexstar is engaged to collect the accounts receivable, and *"neither WYZZ nor any other agent of WYZZ shall make any direct solicitation without Nexstar's written consent of the account debtors for payment"* (*Section 10(d)(ii), Page 8*).
